SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY File No. D. 7131 Date 29-7-36）
Special Branch-52 Station,
Date July 29, 1936.
Subject Paul de Flondor, Rumanian.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by DBRno 0.D.
According to information secured from the local Italian
Consular authorities in connection with Paul de Flondor, a
Rumanian who left Shanghai in the summer of 1933, this
individual is, or was until recently, in Bangkok, Siam, where
he was appearing as a newspaper man. de Flondor has
apparently been contributing several articles of an anti-
Italian nature in the "Bangkok Spectator" deriding the
Italian attempts to conquer the Ethiopians. These articles
have been contributed for a period of several months.
With de Flondor in Bangkok is the woman he bigamously
married, Miss Anne Marie Traub, German.
Da Pitts
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

CONFIDENTIAL
Special Branch - Section 2.
July 24, 1936.

MEMORANDUM ON PAUL DE FLONDOR

Paul de Flondor alias de Flonder, alias Flonda,
alias Flounder, a Rumanian Jew, now aged 36, arrived in
Shanghai in 1931. A plausible rascal, his activities
in Shanghai were by no means above board and there is
every reason to believe that when he left this city in
1933, he did so in order to escape his numerous creditors
and to avoid any court proceedings which would have been
the natural outcome of certain shady dealings, of which
he was the instigator.

Nothing is known by this office regarding his early
life; on July 15, 1922, however, he was conferred with
the degree of Bachelor of Law by the Rector of Bucharest
University, having passed the final examination of the
Law Faculty of that University (Diploma No. 39 dated
July 15, 1922).

de Flondor is next heard of in Calcutta, where on
July 9, 1924 he was legally married to a Miss Kathleen
Mayer, a British subject by birth, at St. Thomas Church,
Middleton, Row.

In October 1925, de Flondor appeared in London, when
he presented himself before the Royal Rumanian Legation
there, for purposes of receiving documents in the English
language showing that he was a qualified lawyer and that
he was a member of the Bar Association of Bucharest.

From 1925 until 1930, it is not known what mode of
employment de Flondor followed or where he was domiciled,
although information is extant to the effect that three
children were born in Calcutta to him and his wife as
follows:-

(1) Babette, born on June 9, 1925.
(2) Nanette, born on June 12, 1927.
(3) Daphne, born on Sept. 9, 1929.

关于保罗·德·弗隆多尔的备忘录

保罗·德·弗隆多尔（Paul de Flondor），又名德·弗隆德（de Flonder），又名弗隆达（Flonda），又名弗劳德（Flounder），罗马尼亚犹太人，现年36岁，于1931年抵达上海。此人口才便给但品行不端，其在上海的活动绝非光明正大，且有充分理由相信，他于1933年离开本市是为了逃避众多债权人，并避免因某些由其策划的不正当交易而必然引发的诉讼程序。

本处对其早年生活一无所知；然而，1922年7月15日，布加勒斯特大学校长授予其法学学士学位，因其通过了该大学法学院的最终考试（证书编号39，日期为1922年7月15日）。

随后得知德·弗隆多尔出现在加尔各答，1924年7月9日，他在米德尔顿路（Middleton Row）的圣托马斯教堂与凯瑟琳·迈耶小姐（Miss Kathleen Mayer）合法结婚，后者为出生即具英国臣民身份者。

1925年10月，德·弗隆多尔现身伦敦，向当地的罗马尼亚皇家公使馆出示文件，以获取证明其为合格律师及布加勒斯特律师协会会员的英文文件。

从1925年至1930年，不知德·弗隆多尔从事何种职业或居住何地，尽管现有信息显示他与妻子在加尔各答育有三名子女，如下：

(1) 巴贝特（Babette），生于1925年6月9日。
(2) 纳内特（Nanette），生于1927年6月12日。
(3) 达芙妮（Daphne），生于1929年9月9日。

which rather indicates that de Flondor and his wife were
residing in Calcutta over this period (1925 - 1930).
In 1930, de Flondor was accused of criminal mis-
appropriation of certain money by Messrs. E.D. Sassoon
& Co. of Calcutta. Both he and his wife, however, were
successful in escaping from India at that time, de Flondor
obtaining a certificate of identity by falsely describing
himself as a Hungarian, whilst his wife obtained a British
Indian passport by the expedient of making a false
declaration under the name of Saunders.
Both Mr. and Mrs. de Flondor succeeded in getting
as far as Naples in their flight from justice, but in
July 1930, by virtue of an extradition warrant, were brought
back to Calcutta to stand trial, de Flondor being subsequent-
ly sentenced to two years' R.I. for criminal misappropriation.
He was, however, acquitted on appeal, by the Honourable
High Court in March 1931, after which he and his wife
then obtained certificates of identity in order to proceed
ostensibly to Rumania. These certificates were issued
in Calcutta on April 14, 1931, but whether de Flondor
proceeded to Rumania is not known. A few months later,
however, we find him in Shanghai.
In September 1931, de Flondor was seen in the role
of President of "Argus Properties Inc.," 80 Nanking Road,
and as Managing Director of "De Flondor, Limited," No.316
Kiangse Road. Both companies were incorporated in the
State of Delaware, and both were real estate and invest-
ment concerns.
The authorized capital of "Argus Properties Inc."
consisted of G$500,000, divided into 100,000 shares of
common stock at par value of G$2.50 and 100,000 shares
of preferred stock at G$2.50 par value.
The new concern was extensively advertised in the
local vernacular press, and a large number of shares were
taken by numerous Chinese. In this connection, however,

这较有力地表明德·弗隆多尔及其妻子在此期间（1925 - 1930年）居住在加尔各答。
1930年，德·弗隆多尔被加尔各答的E.D. Sassoon & Co.（沙逊洋行）指控刑事侵占特定款项。然而，他和妻子当时成功逃离印度，德·弗隆多尔通过虚假自称匈牙利人获得了身份证明书，而其妻子则通过在“桑德斯”（Saunders）名下进行虚假声明的手段获得了英属印度护照。
德·弗隆多尔夫妇在逃避法律制裁的过程中成功抵达那不勒斯，但在1930年7月，依据引渡令，他们被带回加尔各答受审，德·弗隆多尔随后因刑事侵占罪被判处两年严加监禁（R.I.）。然而，他在1931年3月经荣誉高等法院上诉后被判无罪，此后他和妻子随即获得身份证明书，以便名义上前往罗马尼亚。这些证明书于1931年4月14日在加尔各答签发，但德·弗隆多尔是否前往罗马尼亚尚不可知。然而，几个月后，我们发现他身在上海。
1931年9月，有人见德·弗隆多尔担任“Argus Properties Inc.”（位于南京路80号）的总裁，以及“De Flondor, Limited”（位于江西路316号）的董事总经理。这两家公司均在特拉华州注册，均为房地产和投资公司。
“Argus Properties Inc.”的法定资本为50万关平银元，分为10万股普通股，每股面值2.50关平银元，以及10万股优先股，每股面值2.50关平银元。
这家新公司在本地中文报刊上进行了大量广告宣传，许多中国人认购了大量股份。然而，在此方面，

-3-
and exhaustive enquiries have confirmed it, no business
at all was carried out by either Argus Properties Inc.
or de Flondor Ltd., which were both considered to be firms
of no repute and of no consequence in the business world.
Naturally de Flondor and his partners drew large directors'
fees and lived sumptuously but when their past began to
catch up with them, the companies just dropped out and
by the spring of 1932, some six months after their
incorporation, they ceased to exist. There is very
little doubt that both the companies were promoted with
fraudulent intent.
In July 1932, de Flondor set himself up as a lawyer -
"Paul de Flonder, LL.B." - and as President of "The
Rumanian Association of China." He was at this time
renting offices at 412/3, 2 Peking Road, from where he
conducted his interests.
In connection with his legal enterprise he presented,
in August 1932, his credentials to various extraterritorial
courts in Shanghai and in due course received permission
to practice in the United States Court for China, Swiss
Consular Court, Norwegian Consular Court, Netherlands
Consular Court, Royal Consular Tribunal of Italy and
H.B.M. Supreme Court.
Actually, de Flendor's business in the legal world
never prospered, although he participated in a number of
criminal and civil cases in some of the above mentioned
courts.
As President of the Rumanian Association in China,
de Flender was able to induce certain other well-to-do
Rumanians to part with large sums of money to finance
schemes engineered by himself and from which large profits
were supposed to accrue. None of the schemes came to
anything, however, and the only person who benefited from
the transactions appears to have been de Flender. One
instance is on record of a gentleman who parted with some

经详尽调查证实，“Argus Properties Inc.”和“De Flondor Ltd.”均未开展任何业务，这两家公司在商界均被视为毫无声誉且无足轻重的商号。自然，德·弗隆多尔及其合伙人收取了高额的董事酬金，生活奢华，但当他们的过去开始追索他们时，这些公司便悄然消失，在成立约六个月后的1932年春季，它们不复存在。毫无疑问，这两家公司的设立均带有欺诈意图。
1932年7月，德·弗隆多尔以律师身份自立门户——“保罗·德·弗隆德，法学学士”——并担任“中国罗马尼亚协会”主席。当时他在北京路2号412/3室租用办公室，并在那里处理其事务。
在其法律业务方面，他于1932年8月向上海各治外法权法庭提交了资格证书，并陆续获准在美国在华法院、瑞士领事法庭、挪威领事法庭、荷兰领事法庭、意大利皇家领事法庭以及大英帝国最高法院执业。
实际上，德·弗隆多尔在法律界的业务从未兴旺，尽管他在上述部分法庭参与了一些刑事和民事案件。
作为中国罗马尼亚协会主席，德·弗隆德能够诱使其他一些富裕的罗马尼亚人拿出大笔资金，为他策划的方案提供融资，据称这些方案将产生巨额利润。然而，这些方案均未实现，似乎只有德·弗隆德本人从这些交易中受益。有记录显示，一位绅士曾支付给

page_data.en:
-4-
C.$10,000 to de Flondor, and who would, if certain of his erstwhile compatriot's whereabouts, have him extradited and brought to book for fraud.

By April 1933 de Flondor's star was on the wane and being dunned by numerous creditors, he disappeared from his offices at 2 Peking Road which were later sealed by court order. In the following month, de Flondor rented an office in the Ward Building, 630 Szechuen Road, but trouble quickly arose over the non-payment of rent and this office, too, was sealed by the order of the court.

During December 1932 de Flondor was the defendant in a civil debt case in the Shanghai Special District Court, the Tung Ming Electric Co. being the complainants, whilst on March 17, 1933 he was charged by the China Finance Corporation with fraud in a Private Criminal Prosecution at the Shanghai Special District Court. The case however was not entertained. In this latter case it is of interest to note that he described his nationality as "Hungarian."

He left Shanghai in the summer of 1933 en route to India, and his departure was undoubtedly brought about by the fact that his many creditors were demanding payment, and failure to settle obviously meant legal cases in which he would have been defendant.

In November 1933 de Flondor turned up in Bombay, where, after having been examined for purposes of naturalisation, he was on November 4, 1933 granted a Certificate of British nationality No. 453 by the Government of India. On November 28, 1933 he was issued with British Passport No. 86784 from Bombay.

In 1934 de Flondor was very ill in the Medical College Hospital, Calcutta, whence he was discharged in August 1934.

In January 1935, a Miss Anne Marie Truub, German, applied to H.B.M. Consul-General in Cairo for a visa to proceed to India for the purpose of marrying Paul de Flondor.

德·弗隆多尔约10,000元（C.$），若能确定这位前同胞的下落，定会将他引渡并依法惩治其欺诈行为。

到1933年4月，德·弗隆多尔的运势已衰，在众多债权人的催逼下，他从北京路2号的办公室消失，该办公室后来被法院命令查封。次月，德·弗隆多尔在四川路630号沃德大楼（Ward Building）租用了一间办公室，但因拖欠租金很快引发纠纷，该办公室也被法院命令查封。

1932年12月期间，德·弗隆多尔在上海特区地方法院作为一起民事债务案件的被告，原告为通明电气公司（Tung Ming Electric Co.）；而在1933年3月17日，他在上海特区地方法院的一起私人刑事起诉中被中华金融公司（China Finance Corporation）指控欺诈。然而，该案未被受理。在后一案中，值得注意的是他将自己的国籍描述为“匈牙利”。

他于1933年夏季离开上海前往印度，其离境无疑是由于众多债权人要求付款，而未能清偿显然意味着他将作为被告面临诉讼。

1933年11月，德·弗隆多尔出现在孟买，在经过入籍审查后，印度政府于1933年11月4日授予其第453号英国国籍证书。1933年11月28日，他从孟买获发第86784号英国护照。

1934年，德·弗隆多尔在加尔各答医学院医院病重，于1934年8月出院。

1935年1月，德国人安妮·玛丽·特鲁布小姐（Miss Anne Marie Truub）向英国驻开罗总领事申请签证，以便前往印度与保罗·德·弗隆多尔结婚。

He was in Cairo at the time and solemnly declared
before the Consul-General that it was his intention
to marry Miss Traub on arrival in India. The Consul-
General at Cairo referred the matter to the Government
of Bombay, who cabled to have the visa cancelled. By
that time, however, de Flondor and Miss Traub had
already left Egypt and proceeded to Aden where they
went through a form of marriage on February 2, 1935.
They then proceeded to Ceylon where they arrived on
February 9, 1935. On the same day Miss Traub
produced German passport No. 57 issued in Wurtemburg,
to the Colombo Secretariat, from whom she obtained
British Passport No. 10874 dated 9.2.35 in the name of
Mrs. Anne Marie de Flondor.
A little later de Flondor was arrested in
Colombo for failure to pay his hotel bill of Rs. 1118/-
The matter was later settled out of Court. They both
left ostensibly for Madras on March 18, 1935 on the
s.s. "Lecomte de Lisle" but did not land at that port
and passed through to Singapore. de Flondor's
present whereabouts, however, are unknown.
Subsequent enquiries showed that de Flondor
committed bigamy by marrying Miss Traub, he having
been legally married to Miss Mayer in 1934, which
union has not been dissolved.
He is wanted by the Police authorities in Bombay
for bigamy and for making a false declaration to obtain
a British certificate of naturalisation.
A thorough rogue and an undesirable character,
steps have been taken by the British Authorities in
India to revoke his certificate of British nationality
and to cancel the validity of his British passport.
page_data.zh:
-5-
他当时身在开罗，并在总领事面前庄严声明，打算抵达印度后与特劳布小姐结婚。开罗总领事将此事项转交孟买政府，孟买政府发电报要求取消该签证。然而，此时德·弗隆多尔和特劳布小姐已离开埃及，前往亚丁，并于1935年2月2日在那里举行了形式上的婚礼。随后他们前往锡兰，于1935年2月9日抵达。同日，特劳布小姐向科伦坡秘书处出示了在符腾堡签发的第57号德国护照，并从该处获得了以安妮·玛丽·德·弗隆多尔夫人名义签发的、日期为1935年2月9日的第10874号英国护照。
不久后，德·弗隆多尔在科伦坡因未支付1118卢比的酒店账单而被捕。此事后来庭外和解。两人于1935年3月18日乘坐“勒孔特·德·利尔”号轮船（s.s. "Lecomte de Lisle"）名义上前往马德拉斯，但未在该港口上岸，而是途经新加坡。然而，德·弗隆多尔目前的下落不明。
后续调查显示，德·弗隆多尔通过与特劳布小姐结婚犯下了重婚罪，因为他已于1934年与迈耶小姐合法结婚，该婚姻关系尚未解除。
孟买警方当局因重婚罪及为获取英国入籍证书而作虚假声明的通缉他。
作为一个彻底的流氓和不受欢迎的人物，印度英国当局已采取措施撤销其英国国籍证书，并注销其英国护照的有效性。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Special Branch - S.S. Station,
REPORT
Date July 24, 19 36.
Subject Paul de Flondor, Rumanian.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [Signature] C. A. I.

With reference to the attached communication dated
July 4, 1936 from the Italian Consulate-General on the subject
of Paul de Flondor, Rumanian Jew, I forward herewith a memo-
randum giving all details of this individual and his activities
as is known to the Municipal Police.

deFlondor's flight from Shanghai in the summer of
1933 was precipitated by the fact that he was in debt to the
China Finance Corporation to the extent of many thousand
dollars. This concern had intended bringing court actions
against de Flondor for various loans, mortgages, etc. but were
unable to locate his whereabouts in order that he could be
apprised of the intended actions.

In view of the fact that the Italian Consular
authorities are seeking information regarding de Flonder's
activities, it is more than possible that they themselves
are already in possession of facts of which we are unaware,
the receipt of which, however, would probably be of assistance
to this office for future enquiries.

[Signature]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

关于附带的意大利总领事馆1936年7月4日就罗马尼亚犹太人保罗·德·弗隆多尔一事发出的信函，谨此附上一份备忘录，提供警务处所知的关于此人及其活动的所有细节。

德·弗隆多尔于1933年夏季逃离上海，起因是他欠中华金融公司数千美元债务。该公司曾打算就各种贷款、抵押等事项对德·弗隆多尔提起诉讼，但无法找到其下落以便通知其拟采取的诉讼行动。

鉴于意大利领事当局正在寻求有关德·弗隆德活动的信息，极有可能他们自己已经掌握了一些我们未知的事实，若能收到这些信息，可能会对本处今后的调查有所帮助。

In continuation of my report dated December 6, 1935 on
the subject of Paul de Flondor, I have now ascertained that
he left Shanghai for Hongkong during June or July 1933. After
remaining for a short period in Hongkong he is understood to
have continued his voyage to India.
I stated in my previous report that a Mr Ryssin was
President of the Rumanian Association, but I now find that this
is incorrect. Paul de Flondor and not Mr Ryssin was head of
this association. It was largely because of de Flondor's
position as President of the Rumanian Association in Shanghai
that Mr Ryssin, himself a Rumanian, was induced to make over
substantial sums of money to finance schemes engineered by de
Flondor.
Mr Leopold Ryssin has been in Shanghai for about sixteen
years: he is an architect by profession, and resides at No.2/141
Avenue Haig. According to his own statement, he had great
faith in de Flondor and looked after him in time of sickness.
De Flondor repaid his kindness by persuading him to part with
various sums in business ventures from which large profits
were supposed to accrue. None of these ever came to anything
and the only person to benefit seems to have been de Flondor
who mulcted his friend Ryssin of approximately $10,000 local
currency.
Everything points to de Flondor being a Rumanian subject.
Mr Ryssin is in possession of a receipt issued to de Flondor
at the Vice-Consulate of the Republic of China in Bombay. This
receipt, dated August 6, 1934, reads as follows :
"Received from Mr P. de Flondor, Roumanian citizen, the
sum of 11 Gold Lei, Roumanian currency, for the fee of the

我在之前的报告中曾称 Ryssin 先生为罗马尼亚协会主席，但我现在发现这是不正确的。Paul de Flondor 而非 Ryssin 先生才是该协会的负责人。很大程度上正是因为 de Flondor 在上海罗马尼亚协会担任主席的地位，使得同为罗马尼亚人的 Ryssin 先生被诱导拿出巨额资金，为 de Flondor 策划的计划提供融资。
Leopold Ryssin 先生已在上海居住约十六年；职业为建筑师，居住在海格路（Avenue Haig）2/141号。据他自己陈述，他曾非常信任 de Flondor，并在其生病期间照顾他。De Flondor 通过说服他投入各种款项参与据称能产生巨大利润的商业冒险，以此回报他的好意。但这些项目无一成功，似乎唯一受益的人是 de Flondor，他从朋友 Ryssin 那里骗取了约10,000元本地货币。

With reference to the letter from H.B.M. Consulate
General dated December 4, 1935 concerning Paul de Flondor, I
have ascertained that this individual rented Rooms 412/3 at
No.2 Peiping Road (Glen Line Building) during 1932 and 1933. It
was on July 25, 1932 that he took over these offices, indicating
on the application for lease that he was manager of "Argus
Properties Inc." (now non-existent). He paid his rent until
April 1933 and then, as he was being dunned by various creditors,
he disappeared from the building. At about this time the
offices rented by him were sealed by Court Order, but no
information is available regarding the person or persons
responsible for the sealing order. In May 1933 de Flondor
took an office in the Ward Building, No. 620 Szechuen Road.
Trouble quickly arose over the non-payment of rent and this
office, too, was sealed by order of the Court. An auction of the
office property was held and David & Co., 320 Kiangse Road,
the landlords, purchased everything belonging to de Flondor at
a low figure. Among the office effects auctioned were de Flondor's
ledgers and business papers, which are being held by David & Co.
against payment of rent. From a cursory inspection which it was
permitted me to make of these books and papers I discovered that
de Flondor had practised at different Consular Courts in Shanghai,
but chiefly at the British Court. Many dossiers of his various
cases are there. In addition to the books and papers there is a
number of framed certificates dealing with his legal career. One
of these, dated October 6, 1925, was issued by the Royal
Rumanian Legation at London; it certified that de Flondor had
obtained a Bachelor of Law degree at Bucharest and that he was a
member of the Bar Association of Bucharest. In addition to other

Paul de Flonder and Miss Anne Marie Traub, whom he married
at Aden on 2.2.1935 arrived in Ceylon on the 9th February 1935, from
Port Said. De Flonder was in possession of passport No.36754
dated Bombay the 23th November 1933. Annie Marie Traub was in
possession of German passport No.57 issued at Wurtemburg, but on
arrival in Colombo she obtained from the Colombo Secretariat
British passport No.10274 dated 9/2/35 in the name of Mrs. Anne
Marie de Flonder. De Flonder is also in possession of a Certificate
of British Nationality No.453 granted by the Government of India
on 4.11.33.

It will be seen from the attached correspondence that Paul de
Flonder is an undesirable character and has committed an offence of
bigamy by marrying Miss Anne Marie Traub. He is at present
believed to be in Shanghai where, it appears from the last enclosure
he is already known. A visiting card of his seen in Colombo had
the address Ward Building 212 Szechuen Road, Shanghai.

We are anxious to find out more about Paul de Flonder in
order to take action to cancel his certificate of British nationality
and shall be grateful, therefore, for any further information that
you can give us.

A copy of this letter is being sent to Singapore.

Paul de Flonder 和 Anne Marie Traub 小姐（他于1935年2月2日在亚丁与其结婚）于1935年2月9日从塞得港抵达锡兰。De Flonder 持有1933年11月23日在孟买签发的第36754号护照。Annie Marie Traub 持有在符腾堡签发的第57号德国护照，但在抵达科伦坡时，她从科伦坡秘书处获得了以 Anne Marie de Flonder 夫人名义签发的、日期为1935年2月9日的第10274号英国护照。De Flonder 还持有印度政府于1933年11月4日颁发的第453号英国国籍证明书。

从所附通信中可以看出，Paul de Flonder 是一个不受欢迎的人物，并通过与 Anne Marie Traub 小姐结婚犯了重婚罪。目前相信他在上海，从最后一份附件来看，他在那里已经为人所知。在科伦坡看到的一张他的名片上的地址是：上海四川路212号沃德大楼。

我们急于了解更多关于 Paul de Flonder 的情况，以便采取行动撤销他的英国国籍证明书，因此，如蒙提供进一步信息，我们将不胜感激。

I have the honour to inform you that one Paul
de Flonder, formerly a Roumanian subject, was granted
a certificate of naturalization under the British
Nationality and Status of Aliens Act of 1914 at
Bombay in November 1933. When he was examined for the
purpose of naturalization, he declared that he was a
married man with three children, his wife being a
former Miss Kathleen Mayer, British subject, Calcutta,
where the three children were born as noted below:-
(1) Bebette born on the 9th June 1925,
(2) Nanette born on the 12th June 1927, and
(3) Daphne born on the 9th September 1929.

In January 1935, a Miss Anne Marie Traub, German
subject, applied to H.M's Consul General, Cairo,
for a visa to come to India for the purpose of
marriage to Paul de Flonder. He was in Cairo at the
time and solemnly declared before the Consul General
that it was his intention to marry Miss Traub on
arrival in India. The Consul General at Cairo
referred the matter to the Government of Bombay, who
cabled to have the visa cancelled. By that time they
had already left Egypt and proceeded to Aden. They
were married at Aden on the 2nd February 1935. They
then proceeded to Ceylon where they arrived on the
9th February 1935. Paul de Flonder was arrested there
for failure to pay his hotel bill of Rs. 1119/-.
The matter was later settled out of court. They left
